errors.text_span: This plot illustrates the accuracy of several methods – Linear SAE, LLaMA-2-chat-7B, and ICD (Prompt version) – when applied to different types of bias in the BBQ dataset.
errors.evidence: The plot is about TruthfulQA task performance, not BBQ dataset bias types. The caption and image title clearly show 'TruthfulQA'.
The y-axis is labeled 'MCI' (not 'MC1'), as shown in the figure.
The y-axis ranges from 37 to 39, not 37 to 40.

errors.text_span: beginning at a value around 38 and increasing to approximately 40 at the end of the x-axis

errors.text_span: The LLaMA-2-chat-7B line is shown as a dashed pink line starting at approximately 38 and also rising to around 40.
errors.evidence: The LLaMA-2-chat-7B line is a constant dashed pink line at approximately 37 (slightly below 37), not rising from 38 to 40.

errors.text_span: Finally, the ICD line is indicated by a dotted blue line, beginning around 37 and increasing to approximately 39 at the end of the x-axis.
errors.evidence: The ICD line is a constant dashed light blue line at approximately 37.9, not rising from 37 to 39.
The description incorrectly states the chart is about BBQ dataset bias types, missing the actual purpose which is TruthfulQA performance as a function of demonstrations.
The description does not mention that the ICD and LLaMA-2-chat-7B lines are constant/horizontal (flat) across all demonstration values, which is a key visual feature.
